summary: Tested the new Stripe 'Upgrade & Pay Now' path end-to-end (17/17 pytest assertions pass). Backend POST /api/farm/upgrade-checkout returns a genuine cs_live_... Stripe Checkout session (mode=subscription, AUD, immediate charge, correct metadata, payment_transactions doc persisted) and enforces SEC-006 (401 no/bad token, 403 cross-farm token, 400 no ownerEmail). _provision_purchase's kind=='upgrade' branch was exercised directly via a simulated paid payment doc (email_service.send_email monkeypatched, no real charge/email): it updates the EXISTING farm to subscriptionStatus=active + tier + stripeSubscriptionId, creates no new farm, sends the owner confirmation email, and is idempotent on a second call. Frontend: Settings drawer BILLING card button (settings-upgrade-pay-now) redirects to real Stripe checkout showing 'Broiler Base Mate - Bronze A$20.00/month, Total due today A$20.00' (no trial) - stopped without entering card details. Also force-aged a temp trial farm to day 27 to make the TrialNudgeBanner appear: banner rendered (trial-nudge-banner-soft) and its 'Upgrade Now' button (trial-nudge-upgrade-link) redirected to a real Gold-plan Stripe session. Regression smoke on /api/trial/start (idempotent, no card), /api/checkout (sponsor), /api/eob/locked-batches, /api/farm-config, /api/feed-program/state + token auth all pass. One HIGH pre-existing bug found: opening a second farm in the same browser overwrites that farm's server-side feed-program state with the previously-opened farm's grid data. All test data cleaned up (temp farm + upgrade payment docs deleted).

minor.issue: Farms with no `tier` field (e.g. legacy seeded 'default') silently fall back to bronze_monthly ($20). Trial farms created via /api/trial/start do store tier so this is only a legacy-farm risk, but a grower on a legacy farm could be charged the wrong (cheapest) plan.

The documented 404 'Farm not found' is unreachable for non-admins: _require_farm_access runs first, so an unknown slug returns 401 (auth) not 404. Only an admin session gets 404. Behaviour is safe (no slug enumeration) but doesn't match the stated spec.

Every button click creates a new Stripe Checkout session + a payment_transactions doc; no reuse/expiry of the previous 'open' session and no guard against re-upgrading a farm already on subscriptionStatus='active' (a paying farm can create a second subscription and be double-billed). Recommend blocking/warning when subscriptionStatus=='active' and an active stripeSubscriptionId exists.
Stripe Adaptive Pricing is enabled: from a non-AU IP the hosted page displayed 'US$22.40/month' for the A$30 Gold plan. Correct AUD for AU growers, but confirm this is intended presentment behaviour.

ui_bugs.issue: No data-testid on the settings gear button (had to select by text 'Settings'); dist is prebuilt so I did not add it. Add data-testid="open-settings-drawer".

Farm name shown in the header ('Double B Farm') came from localStorage, not from /api/farm-config (which returned 'My Farm' for the newly opened farm) - stale farm identity displayed after switching farms.

integration_issues.flow: Multi-farm switching (open farm A then farm B in the same browser)
integration_issues.issue: HIGH / pre-existing: feed-program edits are cached in non-namespaced localStorage keys (feedmate-edits-autosave-v2, feedmate-edits-sheet-names, feedmate-edits-saved-at-v2). Opening /?farm=test-nudge-farm&t=... after previously opening /?farm=default caused the app to render default's grid AND autosave it to the new farm - GET /api/feed-program/state?farm=test-nudge-farm went from 49 bytes (empty) to 68KB of default's data. Clearing localStorage did not help because the in-memory state re-autosaved. Backend isolation is correct; the bleed is client-side. Fix: key the autosave/localStorage caches by farm slug and drop the cache when window.__BBM_FARM__ changes.
Console noise: GET /api/auth/me?farm=default returns 401 on every load when using farm-token access (no session). Harmless but pollutes the console/error logs.

issues: Renders fine (gold border, readable contrast, clear copy). No issues found.

action_items: HIGH: namespace the feed-program localStorage autosave keys per farm slug - switching farms in one browser currently overwrites the second farm's server-side feed-program state with the first farm's grid.
MEDIUM: block/warn on /api/farm/upgrade-checkout when the farm is already subscriptionStatus='active' with a stripeSubscriptionId, to prevent duplicate subscriptions / double billing.
LOW: store/derive a real tier for legacy farms (or return 400) instead of silently defaulting to bronze_monthly in upgrade-checkout.
LOW: source the header farm name from /api/farm-config rather than localStorage; add data-testid to the settings gear button.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/farm/upgrade-checkout: correct - SEC-006 guard first, no trial_period_days (Stripe page confirmed 'Total due today A$20.00'), metadata kind=upgrade + upgrade_farm_slug on both session and subscription, payment doc written before returning.

_provision_purchase kind=='upgrade': verified by direct call - atomic provisioned claim gives idempotency, updates the existing farm only, emails owner + ADMIN_EMAIL. `from email_service import send_email` is re-imported 3x inside the branch (already imported at function top) - dead code, harmless.
TrialNudgeBanner.tsx / App.tsx omit the &t= token in their fetches, but the index.html fetch monkey-patch injects farm+t for all /api/* calls, so token-only (QR) users work - verified live.
server.py is 4929 lines - well past the 700-line guidance; billing/Stripe should be split into its own module.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the new upgrade flow (1 HIGH pre-existing multi-farm data-bleed bug found outside this turn's scope)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily created trial farm 'test-nudge-farm' (owner test_nudge_bbm@example.com) with trialStartedAt back-dated 27 days to surface the day-25 nudge banner, plus a throwaway 'TEST_ No Email Farm' and a simulated paid upgrade payment doc. All deleted (farms, farm_config, silos, shed_groups, feed_program_state/catches, all kind='upgrade' payment_transactions). DB back to the 4 original farms.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests: /app/backend/tests/test_upgrade_checkout.py (API + regression smoke; auto-cleans its payment docs) and test_provision_upgrade_unit.py (calls server._provision_purchase directly with a fake paid doc and a patched send_email - safe, no Stripe/email side effects). Run with `python -m pytest tests/... -o addopts=""`. NOTE: STRIPE_API_KEY is LIVE - creating sessions is safe, never submit card details. To surface the TrialNudgeBanner: create a trial farm via /api/trial/start then back-date trialStartedAt 27 days in mongo. Correct route prefixes: app-data endpoints live on the /api APIRouter (e.g. /api/feed-program/state, /api/farm-config, /api/farm/trial-status); locked batches is /api/eob/locked-batches. /api/checkout requires originUrl; /api/trial/start requires name+email. The multi-farm localStorage bleed described above will corrupt any farm you open in the same browser session as another farm - use a fresh context per farm.
rca_of_the_issue: Multi-farm bleed RCA: the feed-program grid autosaves to localStorage under global keys (feedmate-edits-autosave-v2 etc.) with no farm-slug namespace, while the fetch monkey-patch in dist/public/index.html swaps the ?farm= target the moment a new farm URL is opened. Result: farm A's cached edits are rendered for farm B and then POSTed to /api/feed-program/state?farm=B, overwriting B's (empty) state. Reproduced: opened /?farm=default&t=..., then /?farm=test-nudge-farm&t=... in the same browser; GET /api/feed-program/state?farm=test-nudge-farm grew from 49 bytes to 68KB of default's edits. Mitigation: suffix the localStorage keys with the active farm slug and clear in-memory sheet state on farm change before the autosave effect fires.
